Name: Nyzam's Remedies
Description: The first three pages of this book contain pressed flowers and botanical diagrams relating to brewing Thuvian remedies.

Ritual.Name: Rejuvenating Infusion
Ritual.Effect: Whenever you imbibe an alchemist extract of a conjuration spell, you can spend this boon as a swift action. If you do, you are healed of 1 point of damage and can ignore the effects of fatigue for 1 round.

Name: Songs of the Linnorm Kings
Description: This book’s cover is made of scales that are warm to the touch.

Ritual.Name: Storied Spell Lore
Ritual.Effect: When you use this meditation ritual, choose a spell of 2nd level or lower in this meditation book. Whenever you cast a bard or skald conjuration spell, you can spend this boon as a swift action to add the chosen spell to your list of bard or skald spells known for 1 round.

Name: Defensive Primer
Description: This surprisingly ornate and heavy volume is more than three-quarters empty. Tightly written notes on the precepts of arcane defense and the vulnerabilities of supernatural entities fill the first two pages.

Name: Apprentice Chapbook of Rul Thaven
Description: This slim book is carefully but amateurishly bound, with leather stretched tight across thin boards. The writing inside is fussy and crammed together, with words that are occasionally illegible. Eight of its pages contain spells; the final 10 pages are blank. A portrait of a plain woman, unsmiling, has been bound into the inside front cover.

Name: The Swordsman's Analects
Description: This book's worn leather cover is emblazoned with a winged sword with an eye at its hilt.

Ritual.Name: Shielding Weapon
Ritual.Effect: Your spells infuse a weapon with protective magic. Spend this boon as an immediate action whenever you cast an abjuration spell. When you do, a weapon you wield grants you a shield bonus to your AC equal to 1 + 1/2 the spell’s level for 1 round.

Name: Unnamed Journal
Description: This is a simple, unadorned spellbook. Notes on improving the efficiency of each spell crowd the margins, most of them hopelessly misguided.

Name: Traveler's Tome
Description: This small book, no larger than a pocket notebook, is bound between wooden covers, and is clearly a copy meant to withstand the rigors of adventuring. The arrowhead lodged in the cover can’t be removed without magic.

Name: Wisdom of Jatembe (Three Warriors Edition)
Description: Well-tanned leather binds this sturdy spellbook, with a copper plate of a stylized animal head bolted to the front cover. A foreword filling the first several pages of this book is addressed to “young students of the Magaambya,” and offers warnings about the unexpected consequences of using spells without careful consideration. The rest of the book contains spells, each proceeded and followed by one or more stories discussing situations with thematic links to the spell.

Ritual.Name: Eyes of Jatembe
Ritual.Effect: Several of the stories within this spellbook suggest ways to take what information you have and use it to infer the answers to questions for which you don’t have proven solutions. Spend this boon when you cast a divination spell to increase the spell’s caster level by +2.

Name: Lab Journal of Constance Inflix
Description: The steel cover of this slim journal has taken its fair share of abuse; acid scars and minor slag spots show where the journal was subjected to intense working conditions. Equations, balances, and chemical notations mark the margins of the pages—with some formulae, it is difficult to tell where the notes end and the formula begins.

Ritual.Name: Alchemical Protection
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon’s effect as an immediate action when you make a saving throw against poison or an alchemical item but before rolling. You gain a +4 bonus on that saving throw.

Name: Book of Harms
Description: The leather wrapping of this book is of an indeterminate type, and gives off a faint and unpleasant scent, as of charred meat. The writing inside is in a jagged hand, and many notes on the ash-smudged pages indicate its previous owner sought ever more damaging magic. A glittering rune in the cover’s center is shaped vaguely like a lightning bolt.

Ritual.Name: Harmful Surge
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon effect as a free action when you cast a wizard evocation spell to treat it as if Maximize Spell was applied; you take 1d4 damage × the level of the spell you maximize. This damage can’t be reduced in any way.

Name: Erages Journeyman's Manual
Description: This book is bound in glittering silver bark, and its title is printed in golden calligraphy in both Elven and Common.

Ritual.Name: Avoiding Spell
Ritual.Effect: Whenever you cast a transmutation spell, you can spend this boon as a swift action to gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s level.

Name: Galtan Cookbook
Description: This book’s cover is illegibly scorched and the pages are wrinkled from water damage.

Ritual.Name: Blast Finesse
Ritual.Effect: As an immediate action when you throw a bomb, you can spend this boon to shape the blast by adding up to three 5-foot squares to the area, as long as those squares are adjacent to the bomb’s normal area.

Name: The Guide's Analects
Description: This book’s worn leather cover is emblazoned with a simplified winged eye superimposed on a map of Avistan.

Ritual.Name: Glorious Blade
Ritual.Effect: When you attack with a sword (including swordlike spell effects that require attack rolls), you can expend a prepared spell or spell slot as a free action to spend this boon. You gain an insight bonus on that attack roll equal to the level of the spell/slot expended.

Name: Book of the Grave
Protection: The edges of the first three pages are coated with nitharit poison (contact; Fort DC 13; frequency 1/minute for 6 minutes; effect 1d3 Con damage; cure 1 save).
Description: This tome reeks of decomposing flesh or some even fouler stench. Grave mold clings to the worm-eaten cover, and dirt stains the pages. Some pages have been torn out.

Ritual.Name: Breath of the Grave
Ritual.Effect: As a swift action, spend this boon’s effect to breathe a 15-foot cone of rotting stench. Creatures in the cone must succeed at a Fort save (DC 10 + your highest caster level in a class that prepares spells) or be sickened for 1 round. After spending it, you take a –4 penalty on Diplomacy and Stealth checks until you prepare spells again.

Name: Journal of the Beast Within
Description: This ragged collection of scorched and stained notes is tied with cheap twine between wooden covers. A few formulae appear to have been deliberately obliterated, scratched through so thoroughly that the paper is torn in places.

Ritual.Name: Beastly Concoction
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon when you imbibe your mutagen. The mutagen grants a +6 alchemical bonus to your selected ability score instead of +4; you take a –2 penalty to all mental ability scores (Int, Wis, Cha) while it lasts.

Name: Grimoire of Glittering Eyes
Protection: The entire book is warded with illusory script (Will DC 16; on failure, the suggestion is for the reader to “Close the book and leave”).
Description: The title of this book is embossed into the scaly cover. Inside, the pages sparkle and gleam in even the faintest light, and the handwriting looks preternaturally clean.

Ritual.Name: Glittering Eyes
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon’s effect as a free action when you cast an illusion spell. You gain darkvision 60 ft. and a +4 bonus on saves to disbelieve illusions for 1 minute.

Name: Arrowsong's Sorrow
Description: This drab leather tome is stamped plainly with elven lettering, appearing at first glance as little more than a journeyman’s treatise on spellcasting. Penned into almost every margin, however, are copious notes by an author who identifies herself only as “Arrowsong.” These annotations discuss numerous spellcasting fallacies made by the tome’s original authors and simple (yet effective) countermeasures that more martially inclined persons can use to disrupt spellcasting. The overall tone of Arrowsong’s notes is one of bitter melancholy, and an equal amount of space is dedicated to slanderous poetry directed toward Arrowsong’s parents and the book’s writers, who might be the same people.

Ritual.Name: Disruption Master
Ritual.Effect: Unlike other boons, you do not spend this one. Until you prepare spells again, when you damage a foe or the foe fails a saving throw against a spell of yours, the foe also takes a –2 penalty on all concentration checks it attempts for 1 round.

Name: Calamaes Fragment
Description: Two gold-plated bronze covers bind this gaudy tome. Several synonyms for “wealth” are neatly chiseled in different languages on the cover.

Name: Tome of the Transmuter
Description: This simple book is bound in white leather with a silver clasp. Careful notes on economic theory in a crisp and precise hand occupy the last few written pages, after which there is a page stained with a dark reddish-brown smear. The rest of the pages are blank.

Ritual.Name: Defensive Transmutation
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon’s effect as a free action when you cast a transmutation spell with a range of personal. As long as you are affected by that spell, you gain a +2 natural armor bonus for the duration of the spell.

Name: The Prying Eye
Description: The front cover of this tome is as black as night, while the back cover is ivory white. An eye-shaped symbol graces both covers.

Ritual.Name: Keen Perception
Ritual.Effect: You can spend this boon to gain a +2 insight bonus on a single Perception or Sense Motive check.

Name: Journeyman Book of Rul Thaven
Protection: Average lock (DC 25), and the 5th-level spells are hidden with secret page. The special word is “reveal.”
Description: This medium-sized book has a creased spine and supple gray leather covers. The leather has rubbed away in certain spots, tiny pinhole burns pock the surface, and a brass lock holds the book shut. A woman’s portrait has been bound into the front cover, and text covers almost all of the image except her face: text in circles, with arrows pointing to new circles with suppositions. Underneath the woman’s chin are the words “Diabolist sacrifice?”

Ritual.Name: Eyes of Rul Thaven
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon’s effect as a swift action to gain the effects of see invisibility for 1 round.

Name: Cold Irony
Description: Bound in thin sheets of iron, this book is designed as a series of treatises on divination, information gathering, and rhetoric. The thoughts and notes are so complete as to qualify as a spellbook for the spells listed, despite the fact the author was a bard with no need for a spellbook.

Ritual.Name: Brain Wash
Ritual.Effect: You can expend this boon when you cast a spell on a creature you have succeeded at a Bluff, Diplomacy, Knowledge, or Sense Motive check against. You cast that spell at +1 caster level and its save DC increases by 1.

Name: Chymist's Guidebook
Description: The pages of this formula book are carefully varnished. Sprinkled among the formulae are details and diagrams of alchemical devices, many of which seem to defy the normal conventions of alchemy and physics. The last page contains incomplete notes on the preparation of experimental mutagens.

Name: Manuscript of Jack Were-son
Protection: Average lock with arcane lock (DC 35) and explosive runes (Reflex DC 16)
Description: Blood, dirt, wine, and more stain this white leather book. The owner’s name, Jack Were-son, is stamped into the cover in peeling gold, yet no more information about the author is immediately evident. Several of the pages contain careful diagrams and illustrations done by a competent but uninspiring artist.

Name: Sarini's Workbook
Description: This book appears to be more of a personal journal than a magical tome. The soft leather binding is worn, and many pages bear the telltale creases of dog-ears and stains of spilled wine.

Ritual.Name: Devilishly Reasonable
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon to gain a +5 bonus on a Diplomacy check against a target that is friendly or helpful to request aid in the form of the target revealing an important secret.

Name: Arctic Call
Protection: fire trap modified to inflict cold damage (Reflex DC 17)
Description: Fine vellum sheets fill these two well-worn books. Beautiful illustrations depict the effects of each spell, many with a distinctly arctic theme. Though the pages and their wintry illustrations are of high quality, the protective leather case that encloses both books smells and feels greasy, as if the hide has been crudely waterproofed with animal fat.

Ritual.Name: Rime Bite
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon as a free action when you cast a spell with the cold descriptor. Any damage from that spell ignores all resistance to cold, but does not ignore immunity to cold.

Name: Tome of Stone Wards
Description: This heavy book is bound between a pair of thin stone tablets, its title carved in gold lettering. Scribed completely in the Dwarven tongue, the text contains numerous tips regarding the construction and upkeep of nearly every corridor, path, and tunnel in the Five Kings Mountains.

Ritual.Name: Keeper of Stone
Ritual.Effect: This boon is not spent. It grants a +1 insight bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering), Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), and Survival checks in hills, mountains, and underground terrain until you next prepare spells. In addition, whenever you cast mending, make whole, or greater make whole on an object made entirely from stone, add 1d6 to the hit points restored.

Name: Cyrusian Codex
Description: This heavy tome bears a handsome leather cover over thick metal plates. The front cover displays a dozen tiny dials arranged in a semicircle around the locking mechanism.

Ritual.Name: Enduring Alteration
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon to apply Extend Spell to a transmutation spell as you cast it, and increase the DC to dispel that spell by 4. This doesn’t change spell level or casting time.

Name: Insights of Far-Seeing Taernis
Description: This slim tome is bound in green leather embossed with geometric constellations. The text focuses on summoning magic and the philosophy of calling allies rather than enslaving them.

Ritual.Name: Cooperative Summons
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon when casting a summon monster spell. The summoned creature gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for the duration of the spell.

Name: Wisdom of Jatembe (Six Warriors Edition)
Description: This edition of Wisdom of Jatembe includes six legendary warriors' stories illustrating the dangers of arrogance and the rewards of insight.

Ritual.Name: Guided Foresight
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon as a free action when casting a divination spell to gain a +2 insight bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

Name: Quest Eternal
Description: Bound in dark leather etched with silver stars, this book details philosophical musings on destiny and fate.

Ritual.Name: Destined Strike
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon before making an attack roll to gain a +4 insight bonus on that roll.

Name: The Formulae of Master Gebr
Description: This formula book contains advanced and dangerous alchemical research attributed to the infamous Master Gebr.

Name: The Last Azlanti's Analects
Description: Bound in deep blue leather embossed with ancient Azlanti sigils, this tome preserves arcane theory from a lost age.

Ritual.Name: Azlanti Precision
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon when casting a spell to treat your caster level as 2 higher for that spell.

Name: Grandfather's Legacy
Description: A somber black tome filled with generational notes on the manipulation of life force and undeath.

Ritual.Name: Legacy of Bones
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon when casting a necromancy spell to gain temporary hit points equal to the spell’s level.

Name: Guardian Grimoire
Description: A thick iron-bound tome detailing the ultimate wards and protective enchantments.

Ritual.Name: Shielded Casting
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon when casting an abjuration spell to gain a +2 deflection bonus to AC for 1 minute.

Name: Mysteries of Shadow
Description: A velvet-bound tome exploring shadow magic and illusion theory.

Ritual.Name: Veil of Darkness
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon to gain concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 round.

Name: Master Books of Rul Thaven
Protection: Arcane lock and symbol of death
Description: The culmination of Rul Thaven’s research, this tome brims with deep planar secrets.

Ritual.Name: Perfect Insight
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon before rolling any d20 to roll twice and take the better result.

Name: Wisdom of Jatembe (Nine Warriors Edition)
Description: The most complete edition of Jatembe’s teachings, recounting nine legendary heroes.

Ritual.Name: Warrior’s Insight
Ritual.Effect: Spend this boon when casting a divination spell to gain a +4 insight bonus on your next attack roll.

Name: Library of the Dancer of Skins
Description: A disturbing compendium rumored to contain polymorphic secrets.

Name: Manual of Binding
Description: An advanced treatise on planar binding and extraplanar negotiations.

Name: Mastery of Word and Thought
Description: A supreme volume on mental domination and psychic control.

Name: Runes of Wealth
Description: A gold-etched tome describing transmutations that generate and manipulate wealth.
